Grottaperfetta — Rome, Italy

Relatively safer day Relatively safer night

In detail

Grottaperfetta is a quiet, largely residential district along Via Cristoforo Colombo, named after ancient quarry caves once found here, with local plans to turn a neglected former green space into a public park. No crime, drug-dealing, or safety incidents specific to this zone were found in current local press. No specific safety concerns documented in recent local press for this area.
